businesses.business: Aircraft engine leasing and aviation services

offering_description.value: The company acquires, leases and resells commercial jet engines and aircraft, and supplies spare parts to airlines and other aircraft operators. It provides fleet planning and financing, runs engine and aircraft maintenance facilities, and offers aircraft storage, disassembly and airport ground and cargo handling.

quotes.quote: A global aviation services leader, we specialize in the acquisition, lease, and resale of commercial aircraft, aircraft engines, and other aircraft equipment, along with spare parts sales, after-market engine parts, and portable aircraft components.

We offer expansive aircraft maintenance, storage, disassembly, and ground and cargo handling services at our facility at Teesside International Airport (UK). In addition, our facility holds UK CAA, EASA, TCCA, 2-Reg and Cayman Authority approvals on A320 family and B737NG aircraft.

primary_products.value: Commercial jet engines; commercial aircraft; aftermarket engine and airframe parts; portable aircraft components

quotes.quote: A global aviation services leader, we specialize in the acquisition, lease, and resale of commercial aircraft, aircraft engines, and other aircraft equipment, along with spare parts sales, after-market engine parts, and portable aircraft components.

Our owned and consigned engine fleet includes over one hundred powerplants ranging from JT8-200s to PW4000s. The majority of these assets are in various stages of disassembly and parts sales processing. Our portfolio of transport category aircraft engines also includes CFM-56s, CF6s, and more, while our airframes are comprised of Classic B737 and A320 aircraft, with teardown A310s and B747-300s reduced to parts.

We also provide a broad range of engine management and consulting services to commercial aircraft operators and MROs. and headquartered in Coconut Creek, Florida, we maintain offices and operations across the United States, Europe, and Asia.
We offer 24/7 AOG support. As the largest independent lessor of commercial aircraft jet engines, we have the power when and where you need it.

We offer one of the broadest product lines in the industry, including engine types from all major manufacturers, lease terms to meet any operational need, engine pools and engine financing, sale leasebacks, forward purchases, finance leases and engine management.
